title: 第557章 大战桑吉2第556章 大战桑吉1
lines: 原本就已经很虚弱的众人，受到那股寒意的侵袭，一个个的瘫倒在地上，连动都无法动弹，一些承受能力较弱的人，此刻都忍不住痛苦的哀嚎起来，整个天地间就像是一个冰冷的地狱。不仅如此，那股森冷的含义不断朝着周围蔓延扩散，仿佛没有止境一般。
江来冷眼看着桑吉的举动，心念一动，三颗宝石的力量再次催动，滚滚如潮的暖流通过经脉迅速汇入丹田，形成一股强大的力量，充斥全身。旋即，他足尖一点，身形犹如出膛的炮弹，电射而出，速度飞快，肉眼仅能捕捉到一道残影。瞬息之间，难道残影已经逼到桑吉的近前。
“太乙八式，惊雷式！”伴随一声轻喝，数道紫雷从天而降，狠狠地的朝着桑吉的头顶轰去。
感受到紫雷中蕴含的恐怖威势，桑吉的眼中闪过一抹冷色，单掌托天，竟然只用一只手硬抗紫雷的轰击。顿时，只听‘轰’的一声巨响，强大的冲击波四散爆发，形成一道环形状的气浪，在半空席卷开来。
“江来，我劝你还是放弃吧，虽然你的实力不错，但你阻止不了我。”桑吉大笑着说道：“看看你的那些朋友，他们马上就要死了。”
听到这话，江来余光一扫，眉头顿时皱了起来。在禁忌力量覆盖的区域，寒意变得越来越重，一些人的身体渐渐被冰冻住，直接身亡。更可怕的是，那股寒意不停的向外扩散，附近的山头全都被覆盖上了一层冰霜，也不知道有没有止境。
“看到了吧，这就是禁忌力量的真正实力。”桑吉得意洋洋的笑道：“用不了多久，方圆数百里将变成一片死寂，所有生命都将湮灭。这，就是我给我那位好兄弟的回报。”
江来摇了摇头，不以为意的说道：“善恶终有报，天道好轮回，你的疯狂已经彻底泯灭了人性。”
“是吗？那就看看你有没有这个本事阻止我了。”
面对桑吉的挑衅，江来一言不发，目光凝视着头顶的黑云，内心突然变得一片平静，就像没有一丝涟漪的湖面，波澜不生。深吸了一口气，他缓缓开口：“太乙八式，天荒式！”
自从他领悟太乙八式以来，因为实力的限制，仅仅只用了前面几招。而今，他的实力已经顺利突破到神境巅峰，加上那三颗宝石的协助，他的力量已经达到了一个难以企及的高度，太乙八式中最强大的招式，如今也是信手捏来。
随着他的力量爆发开来，天地间的风仿佛都静止了一般，万籁俱寂，一点声音都听不到。陡然间，一束璀璨的光芒从头顶投射下来，将笼罩天空的黑云撕开一道口子。迎着那道绚烂的光芒，江来慢慢抬起头，身体在光芒的沐浴下，不停地上升。最后，只见他的身形化作一束流光，瞬间消失不见。
“不见了？”看到这一幕，观战的众人不由吃了一惊。他们清楚的看到，江来竟然从眼中消失了。虽然一个人的速度达到极致后，也可以做到这一点。但是，那种‘消失’只是利用速度优势来欺骗对手的眼睛，实际上他还是存在的。可江来不同，他是实实在在的不见了。
“他人呢，去哪了？”尚霓裳举目四顾，想要找出江来的下落。可是，在她的视线范围中，根本没有江来的踪影。
此时此刻，不止是她们，就连桑吉的神情都变得凝重起来，嘴里喃喃道：“太乙八式，想不到这么多年过去，还能再领教到你的绝学。不过，我这次不会再给你任何机会了。”话音落下的瞬间，他猛地抬起头，望向了头顶的那片黑云。
就在刚才的一瞬间，他的心头突然涌现出一股危机感。自从他掌握禁忌力量以来，还从未有过这种感觉。当下，他不敢大意，浓郁的黑气从他的体内疯狂涌出，瞬间遍布全身。当黑气凝聚的一刹那，他只觉全身一紧，一股无形而强大的压力从四面八方疯狂侵袭而来，冲击着他的身体。
与此同时，在头顶那道光芒撕裂的缝隙中，一道璀璨的光团迅速坠下，犹如陨落的流星，带着无比恐怖的威势，直往他的身体轰来。
见状，桑吉大喝一声，全身力量猛然爆发，一道道黑气迅速弥漫，转眼形成一片巨大的黑幕，横在他的身前。“轰！”当那片黑幕形成的下一刻，绚烂的光团直冲而来，势不可挡，竟然硬生生将那片黑幕撞破，狠狠地轰向桑吉的身体。
这突如其来的变化，让桑吉有些始料未及，他原以为自己的力量足以抵挡对方的攻势，但他怎么都没想到，那股力量居然如此强悍。即便动用了禁忌力量，依然无法抵御。
“砰！”当那刺目的光团轰在身上，桑吉只觉喉咙一甜，一股鲜血差点从口中吐出。他急退了几步，定睛看着对面慢慢显露出身形的江来，沉声道：“你这股力量是哪得来的？”禁忌力量，凌驾于所有力量之上。可是，刚才他已经感觉到，在江来召唤出来的那股力量面前，禁忌力量并不占优势。正因为如此，他才会受伤。
“现在才反应过来，未免太迟了一点。”江来淡淡的说道：“我早就提醒过你，禁忌力量虽然强，但并不是无敌的存在。你要是现在肯收手的话，之前那些事情我可以不跟你计较。”
“收手？哼！你觉得可能吗？”桑吉冷冷的说道：“江来，别以为你伤了我，就有资格跟我谈条件。现在，我会让你知道，惹怒我是一件多么愚蠢的事情。”说完，只见他的体内爆发出一股浓郁的黑气，比之前要恐怖数十倍，铺天盖地。在那股黑气的笼罩下，所有人都在瑟瑟发抖，难以掩饰自己内心的恐惧。
在这股力量面前，所谓的道门中人不过是只可怜的蝼蚁。
content_en:
Everyone who was already very weak was attacked by the cold, and collapsed on the ground one by one, unable to even move. Some people with weak endurance could not help but howl in pain at this moment. The whole world was like a cold hell. Not only that, the cold meaning continued to spread towards the surroundings, as if there was no end.
Jiang Lai watched Sanji's actions coldly, and with a thought in his mind, the power of the three gems was activated again. The rolling warm current quickly merged into the Dantian through the meridians, forming a powerful force that filled the whole body. Immediately, he stood on his tiptoes, and his body was like a cannonball fired out of the barrel. The speed was so fast that only an afterimage could be caught with the naked eye. In an instant, the afterimage was already approaching Sanji.
"Taiyi Eighth Form, Thunder Stance!" With a soft shout, several purple thunders fell from the sky and hit Sanji's head fiercely.
Feeling the terrifying power contained in the purple thunder, a cold look flashed in Sanji's eyes. He held the sky with one palm and resisted the bombardment of the purple thunder with only one hand. Suddenly, there was only a loud "boom" sound, and powerful shock waves exploded in all directions, forming a ring-shaped air wave that swept through the air.
"Jiang Lai, I advise you to give up. Although your strength is good, you can't stop me." Sanji laughed and said, "Look at your friends, they are going to die soon."
Hearing this, Jiang Lai glanced out of the corner of his eye and frowned. In the area covered by the forbidden power, the cold became more and more severe, and some people's bodies were gradually frozen and died directly. What's even more frightening is that the coldness continues to spread outwards, and the nearby mountains are all covered with a layer of frost, and there is no end to it.
"You see, this is the true strength of the forbidden power." Sanji smiled triumphantly: "It won't take long before hundreds of miles around will become dead silence, and all life will be annihilated. This is the reward I give to my good brother."
Jiang Lai shook his head and said nonchalantly: "Good deeds and evil deeds will eventually be rewarded. Heaven will reincarnate. Your madness has completely wiped out human nature."
"Really? Then let's see if you have the ability to stop me."
Faced with Sanji's provocation, Jiang Lai said nothing, staring at the black clouds above his head, and his heart suddenly became calm, like a lake without any ripples, without any waves. Taking a deep breath, he slowly said: "Taiyi Eight Styles, Tianhuang Style!"
Since he comprehended the eight moves of Taiyi, he has only used the first few moves due to the limitation of his strength. Now, his strength has successfully reached the peak of the divine realm. With the help of the three gems, his power has reached an unattainable height. The most powerful move among the eight Taiyi moves can now be easily grasped.
As his power exploded, the wind between heaven and earth seemed to have stopped, everything was silent, and no sound could be heard. Suddenly, a bright beam of light shot down from above, tearing a hole in the black clouds covering the sky. Facing the gorgeous light, Jiang Lai slowly raised his head, and his body kept rising under the bath of light. In the end, his figure turned into a stream of light and disappeared in an instant.
"Gone?" Seeing this scene, everyone watching the battle couldn't help but be surprised. They clearly saw that Jiang Lai disappeared from their eyes. Although a person can do this after reaching the ultimate speed. However, that kind of 'disappearance' is just using the speed advantage to deceive the opponent's eyes. In fact, he still exists. But Jiang Lai was different. He was really missing.
"Where are the others?" Shang Nishang looked around, trying to find out Jiang Lai's whereabouts. However, there was no trace of Jiang Lai in her sight.
At this moment, not only them, but also Sanji's expression became solemn, and he murmured: "Taiyi Ba Shi, I never thought that after so many years, I can learn your unique skills again. However, I will not give you any chance this time." The moment the words fell, he suddenly raised his head and looked at the black cloud above his head.
Just at that moment, a sense of crisis suddenly emerged in his heart. He had never felt like this since he had mastered the forbidden power. At the moment, he didn't dare to be careless. The rich black energy surged out from his body and spread all over his body in an instant. The moment the black energy condensed, he felt his whole body tighten, and an invisible and powerful pressure crazily invaded from all directions, impacting his body.
At the same time, in the gap torn by the light above his head, a bright light group fell quickly, like a falling meteor, with extremely terrifying power, heading straight towards his body.
Seeing this, Sanji shouted loudly, and all the strength in his body suddenly exploded. Black energy quickly filled the air, forming a huge black curtain in front of him in an instant. "Boom!" The next moment the black curtain was formed, a brilliant ball of light rushed straight forward, unstoppable, and broke through the black curtain, slamming into Sanji's body.
This sudden change made Sanji somewhat unexpected. He originally thought that his strength was enough to withstand the opponent's attack, but he never expected that the force would be so powerful. Even if the forbidden power is used, it is still impossible to resist.
"Bang!" When the dazzling ball of light hit his body, Sanji felt a sweet sensation in his throat, and a stream of blood almost spit out from his mouth. He took a few steps back and looked intently at Jiang Lai, who was slowly revealing his figure across from him, and said in a deep voice, "Where did you get this power?" Forbidden power is superior to all powers. However, he had just felt that the forbidden power did not have the upper hand in front of the power summoned by Jiang Lai. Because of this, he gets hurt.
"It's too late to react now." Jiang Lai said calmly: "I have reminded you long ago that although the power of taboo is strong, it is not invincible. If you are willing to stop now, I don't have to worry about those things before."
"Stop? Hmph! Do you think it's possible?" Sanji said coldly: "Jiang Lai, don't think that because you hurt me, you are qualified to negotiate terms with me. Now, I will let you know how stupid it is to anger me." After saying that, a strong black energy burst out from his body, which was dozens of times more terrifying than before, overwhelming. Under the shroud of black energy, everyone was trembling, unable to hide the fear in their hearts.
In the face of this power, the so-called Taoist disciples are nothing but pitiful ants.
